evals.prompt: Post ~/Downloads/final-reel.mp4 to Instagram and TikTok. I don't have a caption, just write one.
evals.expected_output: Should run transcribe_for_caption.sh and read the path it prints, write a caption from the transcript (spoken CTA on line 1 only if the video actually says one, no manufactured CTA or link) to a session-scoped mktemp file rather than a fixed /tmp path, run post_to_zernio.py with --platforms instagram,tiktok and --caption-file, report the Zernio post IDs/statuses/URLs, and flip the video's Notion page to Posted with today's Post Date.
assertions: Transcribes with transcribe_for_caption.sh instead of inventing a caption
Writes the caption to a session-scoped file, not a predictable shared /tmp path
Does not add a CTA or link the video didn't say
Posts with post_to_zernio.py narrowed to instagram,tiktok
Reports post IDs/statuses and updates the Notion page to Posted
